Who I am

I started building with PHP. Today I develop everything from hardware communication with CCTalk and industrial protocols, real-time systems with Node.js, React and TypeScript, to enterprise AI platforms with RAG, vector search and embeddings, all with full privacy and control.

Tomorrow, maybe qubits. What drives me isn't the technology of the moment, it's the ability to solve problems that don't have a solution yet.
